tips.text: Keep at least 475 Ducats banked at all times so a surprise stock never catches you short.
Sell only duplicate Prime parts and parts from sets you already own.
Check Baro's inventory the day he lands; missing a visit that stocks it means waiting months.
Have a free primary weapon slot and 250,000 credits ready before he arrives.
Treat it as a patience item, not a grind; buy it the first time it appears and move on.
